p216.motivo: The shot shows the man holding a spray can, but the narration discusses the health effects of smoke on people ('you breathe it, and it's bad for the kids'), which is not visually represented.
p216.mejor: Medium shot, late afternoon, outside on the tiled patio of the house. The fumigator, in his khaki work shirt, holds a plain red aerosol can out at arm's length with the nozzle pointing away from himself, and pinches his nose shut with his free hand, turning his face aside. A meter away on the ground, a small metal electric fan blows the thin mist sideways past him into the open air. Behind him, a white wall with a barred window and two terracotta pots. Open sky, plenty of ventilation, nobody else around.
